pages.title: Corruption
pages.text: The third is the city's own, the sculk's hunger. A creature that dies within eight blocks of a $(item)sculk catalyst$(), with an awake altar within sixteen, gives that altar four Corruption and twice its experience.$(br2)The catalyst does not bloom then. The altar drinks first.

pages.title: What the Curse Was
pages.text: That is what was wrong with my land. The rift and the sculk together, eating up through the ground. Not the sculk alone, as I believed for a year.$(br2)An altar turns that hunger into something I can spend. Every grief it drinks is one the earth above does not.
